decisions.reason: The camera remains tightly aligned with our core optical and navigation knowledge, and given our strong in-house R&D and mission-learning capability we would refine it rather than withdraw it.
The modular camera line fits our established platform logic especially well, and its several models let us reuse knowledge and improve the line efficiently across applications.

The sensor suite is somewhat broader than our classic products but still draws on adjacent sensing and observation competences that our research base and cooperation network can further absorb and develop.
A radiation-hard space camera is very close to our proven space-imaging expertise, and as a multi-model line it offers strong scope for incremental improvement using existing capabilities.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera builds on our heritage in space vision systems, but its more specialized mission niche and lighter market presence make it more vulnerable than the other products.
